production_invocation.note: Only --pairs-csv, --out-dir, and --verbose 0 are supplied; all solver physics/robustness parameters use production defaults from prepare_autopos_v3_box.py.

baseline_sanity.note: Production fusion rounds fused distances to integer mm and the solver keeps soft geometry priors, so clean synthetic is expected to be near-zero, not bit-exact zero.

verdict_number.interpretation: E3 is endpoint-delay/scale-like and CIR-blind; E4_REAL is the consistent per-link residual that CIR could address.

reference_pairs_schema.directed_link_convention: master -> other endpoint using columns a,b,master
